# netoze — Official AI & Agent Documentation

> netoze is an elite digital infrastructure and local-first network security desktop platform engineered for Windows and Linux. It allows analysts and infrastructure engineers to capture packets, correlate host processes with live network flows, and build verifiable incident briefs with zero cloud telemetry.

## Canonical Resources
- Canonical Serving Host: https://www.netoze.com/
- Public Repository: https://github.com/1viz3r0/netoze
- Public Release Artifacts: https://github.com/1viz3r0/netoze/releases/tag/v2.0.0
- Web Mirror: https://netoze.surge.sh/

## Product Architecture & Core Features
- **Local-First & Zero Telemetry**: All packet captures, flow metrics, and incident briefs remain strictly on local physical hardware.
- **Three-Step Investigation Loop**: Orient (system topology), Trace (process & socket flow correlation), Explain (exportable evidence).
- **100% In-House Architecture**: Independent native packet inspection, socket tracking, and process correlation.
- **Creator & Founder**: 1vi-z3r0 (https://www.linkedin.com/in/1vi-z3r0/)

## Supported Operating Systems
- **Windows 10 / 11 x64**: Executable setup (`.exe`).
- **Linux x86_64**: Debian/Ubuntu package (`.deb`) and portable AppImage.
